name: Weevo
author: weevo

sections.description:
About Weevo

Experience the power of same-day and instant delivery with Weevo’s seamless Shopify integration.
Our cutting-edge technology ensures instant cash cycles and a smooth delivery process.
Let Weevo elevate your e-commerce business with exceptional shipping solutions.

Features:

This Shipping App offers:

1. Pick up creation.

2. Create tracking barcode.

3. Link orders shipped by weevo with tracking number on Orders page.

Prerequisites

You should have weevo credentials, If you are a new customer, please contact us to create an account.

External services

This plugin connects with Weevo’s api services to authenticate merchants and send data for creating shipments and generating barcode and tracking.
Data sent includes Order details and customer information like name/phone/address.
This plugin is provided by Weevo.
policy: https://weevo.net/privacy-policy/
terms & conditions: https://weevo.net/terms-conditions/
weevo api: https://eg.api.weevoapp.com/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Weevo Settings page in WordPress.
  4. Sign in with your Weevo credentials.
  5. Mark your orders and select Send To Weevo.
  6. That’s everything, you can start shipping with us.
